entities.name: Michael J. Fitzgerald

entities.summary: Michael Joseph Fitzgerald is an American prelate of the Catholic Church, having served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Philadelphia in Philadelphia from 2010 until his retirement in 2023.
